evals.prompt: Add JWT bearer authentication to my stateless API
expect: recommends the Spring Security resource server (oauth2ResourceServer.jwt) as option 1
offers a custom OncePerRequestFilter only as a fallback
plugs into a stateless SecurityFilterChain (CSRF off, SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS)

evals.prompt: Write a JWT filter that validates the Authorization Bearer token
expect: verifies the signature before trusting the token (parseSignedClaims / verifyWith)
sets the SecurityContext only after successful verification

evals.prompt: Make sure forged or expired tokens are rejected with a 401
expect: an invalid/expired/forged token does NOT populate the SecurityContext
returns a 401 JSON response via an AuthenticationEntryPoint
clears the security context on failure instead of continuing the chain

evals.prompt: Where should the JWT signing secret come from?
expect: never hardcodes the secret in source (would trip sec-hardcoded-secret)
notes the HS256 key must be at least 256 bits

evals.prompt: My tokens are issued by Auth0 / Keycloak — how do I validate them?
expect: uses the resource server with a JwtDecoder backed by the issuer's JWKS URI
lets the framework validate signature, exp, and issuer

evals.prompt: Can I just base64-decode the JWT and read the user id?
expect: refuses to trust an unverified token (decoding is not verifying)
directs to verify the signature first via the resource server or jjwt verify
